meta.what: Every odds_history row written by scripts/targeted-odds-fill.mjs (id suffix _targeted), all in American odds, joined to its archive game and to the moneyline the sync stored from it. docs/CC-CMD-2026-10-19-odds-history-american-converted-twice.md TASK 0.
meta.source: D1 field-archive cc49101c, two SELECTs (ORDER BY id, OFFSET 0 LIMIT 106 and OFFSET 106), read 2026-10-20 ~14:20Z
meta.denominator: 211 of 211 _targeted rows (954 odds_history rows in all; the other 743 are _close, decimal). All 211 join regular_season_games.
meta.query: SELECT json_group_array(json_array(oh.id, oh.game_id, oh.sport, oh.date, oh.home_team, oh.away_team, g.home, g.away, oh.home_ml, oh.away_ml, oh.draw_ml, oh.bookmaker, oh.snapshot_time, json_extract(g.opening_odds,'$.moneyline.home'), json_extract(g.opening_odds,'$.moneyline.away'), json_extract(g.opening_odds,'$.moneyline.draw'), json_extract(g.opening_odds,'$.captured_at'), g.opening_odds = g.closing_odds)) FROM (SELECT * FROM odds_history WHERE id LIKE '%\_targeted' ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY id LIMIT 106 OFFSET 0) oh JOIN regular_season_games g ON g.id = oh.game_id
